groups.heading: Data delivery platform
bullets: Designed and delivered a service that consolidates incoming data into a consistent format for downstream applications. Owned implementation, integration testing and the production rollout.

groups.heading: Performance and reliability
bullets: Introduced profiling and repeatable benchmarks to investigate slow requests. Added regression checks and operational dashboards so engineers could track behavior after deployment.

groups.heading: Engineering collaboration
bullets: Worked with product and infrastructure colleagues to turn requirements into incremental releases. Documented design decisions and supported teammates through reviews and troubleshooting.

groups.heading: Service modernization
bullets: Replaced a manual reporting workflow with an automated pipeline. Designed the data model, implemented scheduled processing and exposed the results through an internal API.

groups.heading: Developer tooling
bullets: Built a reusable local test environment and deployment checks to make releases more predictable. Helped the team reproduce failures before changes reached production.

groups.heading: Mentoring and outreach
bullets: Prepared onboarding exercises and coached new engineers through their first contributions.
Helped organize student workshops and demonstrated how the team approaches practical software problems.
Implemented a prototype for analyzing time-series data and reviewed the results with the research team.
Added automated tests and documentation so subsequent contributors could extend the prototype.
